content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean in closer, fingers brushing the blade's edge ||| "I wonder what your questions will really reveal, Julian."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, withdrawing my hand from his grip ||| "I won't play your game, Julian. Not here."  
CONFESSION ||| Hold his gaze, breath steadying in the tension ||| "Your presence makes me question everything I thought I knew."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade firmly, tilting it toward the others ||| "I'll answer, but only if you admit your part in this."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, eyes locked on Julian, heart racing |||
